overview.description: IBM Technology Zone supports multiple infrastructure platforms, each with specific post-deploy contexts, variable structures, and content module types. This guide provides platform-specific guidance for creating Ansible playbooks and manifests.
overview.critical_principle: The platform determines which infrastructure and request variables are available in post-deploy playbooks. Always fetch the latest post-deploy context from techzone-documentation-mcp under "The Lifecycle of an Asset & Architecture" section "Types of Content Modules".

context.description: Variables available in Terraform GitOps Post-Deploy playbooks for watsonx SaaS Shared and Account Vending platforms

variables.variable: account_api_key - IBM Cloud API key for authentication
requester_id - User ID of the requester

access_pattern.description: Variables are passed as JSON strings that must be parsed
access_pattern.example:
# Parse account variables - name: Parse account variables set_fact: account_json: "{{ account_variables | from_json }}"
# Access specific values - name: Use account API key set_fact: api_key: "{{ account_json['account_api_key'] }}"

context.description: Variables available in Terraform OS Post-Deploy playbooks for OCPV and VPC VM platforms

variables.variable: vm_ip_address - IP address of the VM
requester_id - User ID of the requester
ssh_key - SSH public key for access

access_pattern.description: Variables are directly available in playbook context
access_pattern.example:
# Variables are passed directly from environment override vars: custom_variable: "{{ custom_variable }}"
# Use in tasks - name: Display VM information debug: msg: "VM IP: {{ vm_ip_address }}, Hostname: {{ vm_hostname }}"

context.description: Variables available in Terraform Post-Deployer playbooks for OpenShift cluster deployments

variables.variable: cluster_name - Name of the OpenShift cluster

step.action: Use techzone-documentation-mcp to fetch "The Lifecycle of an Asset & Architecture" section "Types of Content Modules" to get current post-deploy context for all platforms
step.frequency: Every session - never cache this information

step.title: Fetch Platform-Specific Documentation
step.action: Based on identified platform, fetch the specific documentation articles listed in the workflow instructions
step.critical: Always fetch Part 4: Adding Post-Deploy customisation (advanced)

step.action: Retrieve platform-specific instruction articles (e.g., "Instructions for generating Ansible Playbooks for IBM Cloud Services")

practice.rule: Always confirm platform before generating content
Use ask_followup_question if platform is ambiguous
Explain platform differences when presenting options
Fetch documentation at start of every session
Never rely on cached or remembered documentation
Reference specific documentation sections in responses
Inform user if documentation structure has changed
Include variable parsing for IBM Cloud Services platforms
Use direct variable access for Base VM platforms
Always validate variable availability before use

example_environment_retrieval_restrictio.title: CRITICAL: Example Environment Retrieval Restrictions
example_environment_retrieval_restrictio.description: When retrieving example environment definitions using techzone-request-mcp, you MUST use ONLY the specific platform IDs based on the platform type. NO OTHER SEARCHES should be performed outside these fixed platform IDs.

critical_rules.rule: ONLY use the seven fixed platform IDs listed in 7_platform_mapping.xml
DO NOT search by request name, title, description, or any other criteria
DO NOT use wildcards, partial matches, or multiple platform IDs
DO NOT attempt to list all requests without a platform_id

allowed_operations.operation: Search with exactly one of the seven fixed platform_id values
Use limit parameter to control result count (optional)

forbidden_operations.operation: Using any search parameters other than platform_id
